description: Launch the visible Gretl desktop GUI, optionally opening a local dataset/script or running a provided script on startup.

english.description: Force Gretl GUI to use English.

filePath.description: Optional local dataset or script file to open in the Gretl GUI.

gretlGuiPath.description: Optional explicit path to gretl or gretl.exe.

newInstance.description: Launch a new Gretl GUI instance instead of reusing an existing one.

runScript.description: When filePath points to a script, launch Gretl with --run filePath.

safeMode.description: When script is provided, block shell-like commands and absolute file reads/writes.

script.description: Optional Gretl/Hansl script to write and open with --run in the GUI.

workspaceRoot.description: Optional directory where GUI script workspaces are created.

name: gretl_gui_launch
